He confirmed that the names in the System column are well-known celestial objects at that location, NOT proper system names; these are not meant to create new system names nor override those from pre-existing EU (ie, the name of [[Azurbani system]] has NOT been changed to [[Kiffex/Legends|Kiffex]] system, nor [[Ten Tempests system]] to [[Vortex/Legends|Vortex]] system, etc.).}} [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', has confirmed the connection between [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] listed in the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] and similarly named [[Planet/Legends|planets]], such as the Couronne system and the planet [[Couronne/Legends|Couronne]].</ref>

The '''Couronne system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Couronne sector/Legends|Couronne sector]],<ref name="Atlas" /> within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion<ref name="Slice" /> of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="Atlas" /> It contained<ref name="JCF" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SW article">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-maps-charting-the-galaxy|text=''Star Wars'' Maps: Charting the Galaxy|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Couronne/Legends|Couronne]],<ref name="JCF" /> the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Imzig]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Rogues Gallery" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Couronne system was created for the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]]&mdash;a [[StarWars.com]] supplement to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' from co-authors [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]&mdash;which placed the system in grid square P-10.<ref name="Atlas" />
